summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest US movers.

• 6 upside misses — MRNA +13%, FDS +11%, NOW +10%, WDAY +9%, DDOG +9%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (ON -24%, WDC -13%, STX -12%, SNDK -10%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: ON (-23.66%) — ON Semiconductor announced a ~$7B all-stock acquisition of Synaptics on June 25 (physical-AI pivot); investors punished heavy share dilution and execution risk, sending the stock down ~24% over June 26–29. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe. Even if added, profiting required a short on the acquirer immediately post-announcement — a pre-market catalyst gap that no momentum or mean-reversion signal using prior-session data can reliably front-run.

top_movers.catalyst: 9-0 FDA advisory panel vote backing Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine mFLUSIVA (mRNA-1010) ahead of Aug 5 full approval decision, amplified by Science Day pipeline reframe across oncology, autoimmune, and AI-driven mRNA programs.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe. MRNA is a large-cap biotech with binary FDA event risk and was already up 40%+ in June (+125% YTD) before this session; a name this extended on a pre-flagged calendar catalyst is typically excluded by both RSI ceilings and event-gate rules that freeze positioning around known adc
top_movers.suggestion: Add a post-adcom momentum gate: names with a unanimous (≥8-0) FDA advisory vote within the prior 5 sessions and a session-open gap ≤+8% become eligible for a single-session momentum entry, with position sizing capped at 0.5× normal to contain binary approval risk.

top_movers.catalyst: FactSet announced a strategic investment in and partnership with TIFIN.AI on June 29, embedding agentic AI advisor tools (Meeting Prep Agent, Book Intelligence Agent) into FactSet Workstation; pre-earnings drift into the July 1 Q3 call and 15.86% short float amplified the move.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — FDS is a ~$8B mid-cap financial data/analytics provider. The move required same-day press-release monitoring plus pre-earnings positioning; no momentum or mean-reversion signal would have flagged it pre-open, and short-squeeze dynamics further compressed the entry window.
top_movers.suggestion: Expand a news-gate strategy's watchlist to include financial-data peers (FDS, MSCI, MORN); trigger universe inclusion when a partnership/AI press release drops ≤3 trading days before a scheduled earnings call on a name with short interest ≥10% of float.

top_movers.catalyst: ServiceNow and Accenture jointly launched AI-powered agentic risk-platform migration services, reigniting bullish sentiment around NOW's enterprise AI monetization ahead of July 29 earnings.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — NOW is a large-cap SaaS name (~$90B+ mkt cap) above the bot's likely cap/sector filters. The catalyst was an intraday partnership announcement requiring news-reactive logic the current strategies don't have.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a news-reactive catalyst scanner for large-cap SaaS/cloud names: if a major partnership announcement drives intraday surge ≥7% with volume ≥2× 20-day avg, permit a momentum entry within 60 min of the headline timestamp.

top_movers.catalyst: Monness Crespi Hardt upgraded WDAY to Buy (from Neutral) with $150 PT, citing depressed valuation and strong AI-driven cash flow; broad enterprise-SaaS sector tailwind amplified the +9% move.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — WDAY is a large-cap enterprise SaaS name (~$21B mkt cap) unlikely to appear in smaller-cap or sector-specific momentum screens. Analyst-upgrade catalysts also print pre-market, before intraday signal generation.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a sell-side upgrade event screen (≥1 Buy/Outperform initiation or upgrade intraday with price-target ≥+10% above prior close) as a universe expansion trigger, with a pre-market gap floor of ≥+3% to filter noise.

top_movers.catalyst: Cluster of bulge-bracket analyst upgrades (Truist Buy/$300, Arete $340, Citi $270, BMO/Needham $260) citing accelerating agentic-AI observability demand; volume ran ~2× daily average confirming institutional accumulation.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — DDOG is a large-cap NASDAQ cloud-software name (~$50B+ market cap), above typical small/mid-cap universe bounds. The move was an analyst re-rating cluster; capturing the gap required pre-market news parsing before price gapped up at the open.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a large-cap news-reactive layer that screens for ≥3 analyst PT raises of ≥15% within a rolling 5-day window, entering at open only if the intraday gap is <+4% to avoid chasing; otherwise queue for a pullback limit.

top_movers.catalyst: Q1 FY2027 earnings beat ($882.9M revenue, +16% YoY vs $857.7M est.; EPS $2.24 vs $2.02 est.), FY27 guidance raised to ~$3.64B, and June 23 Falcon MLR AI launch (regulatory content automation) with Vault CRM wins at Teva and Merck KGaA.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — large-cap life sciences SaaS (~$27B market cap). The primary earnings catalyst printed June 3, 26 days before today's move fully materialised; the stock's slow re-rating from compounding AI/CRM news resists reactive intraday signals and requires pre-event or post-earnings-drift
top_movers.suggestion: Add a post-earnings-drift screen: flag names with ≥5% EPS beat plus a guidance raise that have not recaptured their initial gap-up close within 20 sessions, and enter on a breakout above that level with a one-ATR stop.

top_movers.catalyst: ON Semiconductor announced a ~$7B all-stock acquisition of Synaptics on June 25 (physical-AI pivot); investors punished heavy share dilution and execution risk, sending the stock down ~24% over June 26–29.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe. Even if added, profiting required a short on the acquirer immediately post-announcement — a pre-market catalyst gap that no momentum or mean-reversion signal using prior-session data can reliably front-run.
top_movers.suggestion: Add an M&A-acquirer watchlist: when a universe-adjacent large-cap gaps down >15% on an all-stock deal announcement, flag it for a mean-reversion long entry (not short) on day 2–3 if volume normalises — actionable without requiring short capability.

top_movers.catalyst: Retirement of $858M convertible notes for ~21.3M new WDC shares caused material dilution, compounding the June 22 SanDisk exchange overhang and sector fears from SK Hynix's AI-memory production pivot.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe. WDC's ~1,000% YTD rally stretched forward P/E to ~43×; corporate-action-driven gaps (8-K share issuance ≥5% float) are structurally invisible to momentum and mean-reversion technical filters that have no earnings-gate or dilution flag.
top_movers.suggestion: Add an 8-K corporate-action monitor: names filing share issuance ≥5% of float auto-enter a mean-reversion watchlist for that session, letting the strategy fade dilution-driven gap-downs intraday without requiring pre-market positioning.

top_movers.catalyst: Broad memory/storage sector rout: Fox Advisors downgrade (Jun 22) + SK Hynix HBM slowdown report rattled AI-hardware complex; hawkish Fed repricing under Chair Warsh piled on, erasing ~12% from STX's 290% YTD run.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe. At ~$900/share with a trailing P/E of ~98x, STX sits in high-multiple large-cap tech — above typical price/valuation caps. The drop was macro/sector-driven and multi-day, not a clean momentum or gap signal catchable intraday.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a correlated-sector selloff gate: if ≥3 AI-storage proxies (e.g. MU, WDC, NVDA) each drop ≥3% on the same session, flag high-multiple storage names for a mean-reversion short watchlist even outside the normal universe cap.

top_movers.catalyst: June 2026 Russell US Index Reconstitution (effective June 29) reclassified SNDK from Value to fully Growth, forcing large passive value-fund outflows that overwhelmed growth-fund inflows on a stock already up 781% YTD.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe; SNDK's ~$2,090 share price and 781% YTD run likely exceeded the bot's price or volatility caps. The -10% move was a passive-fund structural rebalancing event — no actionable pre-close momentum or mean-reversion signal existed.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a Russell-reconstitution event gate: on the reconstitution effective date, flag Value→Growth reclassifications down ≥8% at open as mean-reversion fade candidates, with a hard 1-session hold limit and a universe price cap override for that day only.
